evidence_sentence: It checks for conditions that prevent peeling off, such as active wait queues or unsupported socket types.
rationale: The fixed implementation adds a waitqueue_active(&asoc->wait) check that rejects peeling with -EBUSY when the association has active waiters. The vulnerable implementation checks only association existence and UDP socket style; it has no active-wait-queue condition. The docstring explicitly names active wait queues as a condition preventing peel-off, thereby describing the fixed-only guard.
rewritten_docstring: The function first retrieves the SCTP association using the provided ID. It checks whether the association and socket are eligible for peeling off. If valid, it creates a new socket, copies properties from the original socket, and migrates the association to the new socket before returning it through the sockp parameter.
